# A fund declared at a finer fraction than the book holds it at.
#
# A security's fraction *is* written into the file, unlike an ISO currency's,
# so restating one is a real change and the book has to be saved for it.
#
# Imported with `--include-business-objects`, the account pre-pass makes the
# change before the transaction pass runs — so the transaction pass finds the
# fractions equal and reports nothing, and if the pre-pass did not carry the
# distinction through, the run reported an update and then threw it away. The
# same file saved without the flag and not with it.
#
# What this fixture produces: FUNDX restated from 100 to 1000, and nothing
# else — no transaction, no account, so the fraction is the only reason to
# save.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_fund_fraction_is_saved_with_either_flag.py.
2026-01-01 commodity FUNDX
	mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	fullname: "Example Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 1000
